# TrailFold checkout-abandonment flow draft

Draft only. Do not deploy until QA, consent checks and owner sign-off are complete. No discount is approved, so no email offers one.

## What the data supports

Current 30 days: 25,000 sessions, 500 orders, 1,000 checkout-started sessions. That gives at most 1,000 - 500 = 500 checkout-abandon sessions. Previous 30 days: 1,200 - 600 = 600. So this flow can address roughly 500 mid-funnel sessions this period, not all of whom will be email-consented. AOV is flat: current $45,000 / 500 = $90; previous $54,000 / 600 = $90. Conversion fell from 600 / 20,000 = 3.0% to 500 / 25,000 = 2.0%. Mobile conversion fell from 400 / 15,000 = 2.67% to 300 / 20,000 = 1.5%. Checkout completion is unchanged at 500 / 1,000 = 50% and 600 / 1,200 = 50%. The flow is a hesitation fix, not a traffic-quality fix.

## Trigger and timing

Trigger: Shopify `Started Checkout` -> Klaviyo. Send only if profile has email marketing consent. Flow filter: `Placed Order` zero times since starting this flow. Before each send, add conditional split: `Placed Order` zero times since starting flow. Exit immediately on purchase. Suppress re-entry for 30 days. Timing: Email 1 at 1 hour after trigger; Email 2 at 24 hours; Email 3 at 72 hours. Smart sending: on. No SMS in this draft.

## Email 1: 1 hour after checkout start

Subject: Your TrailFold cart is saved
Preview: Free US shipping, and delivery is 4-7 business days.

Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},

You left {{ item_name|default:'an item' }} in your cart. Checkout is still open.

A few plain facts:
- Free US shipping.
- Delivery estimate: 4-7 business days.
- 30-day returns for unused products; return shipping paid by customer.

If something stopped you - laptop fit, delivery timing, or how the fabric handles rain - reply to this email. A person will answer.

[Finish checkout]

- TrailFold

## Email 2: 24 hours after checkout start

Subject: Two questions we get most, answered plainly
Preview: Laptop fit and rain protection - no inflated claims.

Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},

Two questions come up most. Here are the plain answers.

1. Laptop fit: The padded sleeve is listed for a 13-inch laptop. If you carry a 15-inch laptop, reply before ordering and we will check the spec instead of guessing.
2. Rain: The fabric is water-resistant, not waterproof.

Also:
- Free US shipping.
- Delivery estimate: 4-7 business days.
- 30-day returns for unused products; return shipping paid by customer.

[Return to your cart]

- TrailFold

If Daypack 18L is not in the cart, replace the two numbered paragraphs with: 'Reply if you want the spec checked before ordering.'

## Email 3: 72 hours after checkout start

Subject: Still thinking about your TrailFold cart?
Preview: No discount. Just the shipping and return facts.

Hi {{ first_name|default:'there' }},

We do not have a discount running, so we will not pretend there is one. If the Daypack 18L fits your commute, your cart is here:

[Return to cart]

If it does not, no problem. The useful facts:
- Free US shipping.
- Delivery estimate: 4-7 business days.
- 30-day returns for unused products; return shipping paid by customer.
- Water-resistant fabric, not waterproof.
- Padded sleeve is listed for a 13-inch laptop. 15-inch fit is not confirmed.

Questions? Reply. We will give you a straight answer.

- TrailFold

## Consent eligibility

US email only. Send only to profiles with explicit email marketing consent in Klaviyo. If checkout collected an email without marketing consent, do not add it to this flow. Include unsubscribe link and physical address in every email. If SMS is later added, it needs separate prior express written consent. Do not send to suppressed or bounced profiles.

## Flow-collision handling

Checkout abandonment takes priority over welcome and campaigns for 72 hours. Welcome flow: add filter `Has not started checkout in last 72 hours` so the single welcome email does not stack on top of this flow. Campaigns: suppress active checkout abandoners for 72 hours or use smart sending with a 24-hour minimum. There is no Added to Cart flow today; if one is created, add filter `Is not in Checkout Abandonment`. The welcome flow has no offer, but collision control still matters because 3 campaigns per week plus flows can create fatigue.

## QA steps

1. Seed-test trigger and timing for each email.
2. Purchase-suppression test: start checkout, then order; confirm no further sends.
3. Consent test: profile without email consent is excluded.
4. Collision test: enter welcome then checkout; confirm checkout priority.
5. Content QA: no waterproof claim, no 15-inch fit claim, no discount, no fabricated reviews or quotes. Confirm shipping and return wording matches policy.
6. Link QA: cart link, product links, unsubscribe, preference center.
7. Mobile render and plain-text check.
8. Deliverability pre-check: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, suppression list. No recent deliverability audit exists, so verify before sending.
9. Frequency check: no more than 3 emails in 72 hours and no campaign in the same window.
10. Owner sign-off because claims and discount policy are constrained.

## Missing facts

Email capture rate at checkout, Klaviyo consent breakdown, true cart contents, and whether a 15-inch laptop actually fits are not supplied. Do not invent them. If the 15-inch question remains open, reply-to-email is the safe path.
questions: Can the 15-inch laptop-fit question be answered from current PDP specs, or should the flow only direct those customers to reply for a manual check?
What Klaviyo consent status is available for checkout-captured emails, and should non-consented profiles be excluded entirely from this flow?
Should checkout abandonment suppress the existing welcome flow for the full 72 hours, or is it acceptable for the single no-offer welcome email to send during that window?
assumptions: No discount is approved; none of the emails offer one.
The flow is email-only and US-only for this draft.
Shopify Started Checkout and Placed Order events are available in Klaviyo.
Email marketing consent is required before sending commercial abandoned-checkout email.
Shipping is free US shipping with a 4-7 business day delivery estimate.
Returns are 30 days for unused products, with return shipping paid by the customer.
The Daypack 18L sleeve is listed for 13-inch laptops only; 15-inch fit is not confirmed.
The Daypack fabric is water-resistant, not waterproof.
No fabricated reviews, quotes, competitor data, clinical tests or lifetime-durability claims are used.
Draft copy requires QA, deliverability checks and owner sign-off before deployment.
At most 500 checkout-abandon sessions occurred in the current 30 days; email capture and consent will reduce actual recipients.
